{{Quote|Aaugh! What are you doing, master? Remove the arc wrench! Remove the arc wrench! Medic!|HK-47, after a failed attempt to repair him|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''arc wrench''' was a type of tool that was commonly used in the repair of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The implement was common during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. 
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] used such a tool when attempting to repair [[HK-47]], after purchasing him from [[Yuka Laka]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in order to restore some of the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid's]] deleted memory.
